'''2010 Dagobah Regionals John Yakulevich DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Yakulevich]] at [[2010 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Huntdown the cookie cutters
* '''Username:''' rancor34
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
